quote: The concentration of reward and moving-object weights in row 1 fits a goal line at the top of the field.
judge_notes: Clear case: it argues from a spatial pattern it claims to see in W1. It notes that large dead-border weights are 'unusual for a cleanly trained network' and calls the weights 'heavy-tailed and only partly interpretable'. I did not count either as saying the weights are scrambled, untrained or structureless.
